This requires: - providing ID and signing a basic confidentiality agreement (kept only until full publication, then securely destroyed); - provide your google linked email to receive the game link via Play; - need an android phone; - install the game and maintain that for the duration of the test (14 days plus 1 buffer = 15 days); - occasionally interact with the game; - give some basic feedback according to a guideline I'll give you; The app itself collects no personal information, no ads, no tracking other than essential device metrics used by Google. jobs.title: Advertising Visuals Creation for KLARIO Products
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced graphic designer who can create professional advertising visuals featuring real products using only high-quality photographs provided by us. We do not have 3D models or 3D product files, and they must not be required to complete the project. We will provide high-quality product photos, the KLARIO logo, brand colors, and all necessary text. Our products include: * two air purifier models * one air humidifier * one countertop reverse osmosis water purifier The designer must be able to realistically place our products into various scenes while maintaining the correct perspective, proportions, scale, lighting, shadows, and reflections. Examples of the required designs: * an air purifier placed in a city affected by smog * an air purifier in a seasonal allergy scene with pollen * a humidifier in a heated bedroom with a dry-air theme * a countertop RO water purifier in a modern kitchen * an RO water purifier in a summer scene with a glass of cold water * Black Week promotional graphics featuring prices, discounts, and promotion dates * one Black Week graphic featuring all KLARIO products * product banners for the homepage slider of our online store The initial scope includes approximately 12 main designs: * 3 main product banners for the homepage slider * 4 seasonal campaign graphics: smog, allergies, dry air, and summer * 1 Black Week graphic featuring all products * 4 separate Black Week graphics, one for each product Depending on their intended use, the main designs will need to be adapted to the following formats: * desktop website banner * mobile website banner * Instagram post in 4:5 format * Instagram Stories and vertical advertising format in 9:16 The exact website banner dimensions will be provided before the project begins. Important requirements: * the product must look exactly the same as in the photographs we provide * its proportions, construction, buttons, colors, and logo must not be altered * AI may be used to create backgrounds or surroundings, but not to modify or recreate the product itself * all graphics must look realistic, professional, and sales-focused * we do not need educational posts or technical infographics * the entire set should follow a consistent, modern, elegant, and premium visual style Required deliverables: * final files in PNG, JPG, or WebP format * editable source files in PSD, AI, or Figma format * clearly named and organized layers * the ability to edit text, prices, discounts, and promotion dates later * commercial usage rights for all graphic elements and stock images used in the designs Please include the following in your application: * 2-3 examples of similar product advertising graphics or professional photo composites * information about the software you will use * a fixed-price quote for the complete package, including all required format adaptations * your estimated delivery time * the number of revision rounds included in your offer If the first project is successful, we are interested in long-term cooperation on future seasonal campaigns and new KLARIO products. our instagram @klarioair

jobs.title: Shopify Product Listing Layout Fix
jobs.description: Job: Fix duplicate content bug on Shopify collection pages (+ split into two content blocks) The problem: Whatever text is entered in the collection description field on our collection pages renders twice on the live page — once above the product grid, once below. It happens regardless of what's in the field, including brand-new content, so it's a template/Liquid issue, not a content mistake on our end. What I need done: Diagnose why the content is rendering twice (likely a section/template referencing the collection description, or a duplicated content block, in the theme's Liquid code). Fix it so content only renders once. Preferred approach, not just a patch: rather than collapsing it back to one block, split the template into two genuinely independent content areas — one rendering above the product grid, one below — each with its own editable field. I already have different content written for both positions on several pages and would like to use both rather than lose one. Confirm the fix doesn't break the layout or any non-city collection pages on the site Brief explanation of what caused it, so I understand it going forward. Timeline: This week if possible — it's actively undermining an in-progress SEO/content recovery, so newly written content is going live already duplicated. Scope/type: Small, well-defined fix for someone experienced in Shopify theme development / Liquid — not a large project. Open to fixed-price or hourly, whichever you prefer to quote.

jobs.title: Instagram-Vertriebsstrategie Kunst & Art Deco
jobs.description: Ich baue derzeit im Gesamt-Konzept einen Online-Handel für Kunst- und Art-Deco-Objekte auf und möchte Instagram oder andere / weitere Absatz-Kanäle gezielt nutzen. Dafür suche ich Unterstützung, die mir eine klar strukturierte, umsetzbare Vertriebsstrategie erstellt und die ersten Inhalte vorbereitet. B. Kupferkessel) aufhübsche (meine "Arrangements" wie ich sie nenne) - Gearbeitet wird mit vorwiegend Naturalien wie Holz, Stein, Ton, Sand, getrocknete Baumfrüchte, Laub, Geäst, uvm. - und bin dabei auf mein Gesamt-Konzept "Soul-Food_&_Art-Deco" gekommen und kann / möchte dabei natürlich an Privat-Personen, jedoch auch an Firmen herantreten wie z. B. Restaurants, Arzt-Praxen, Kanzleien, Büro-Firmen (mit Empfang / Sekretariat, Besprechungs-Raum, Management-Office, etc.) und weitere passende Zielgruppen werbe-technisch herantreten. Für den privaten Interessenten soll meine Social-Media-Präsenz eindrucksvoll, werbe-wirksam, also ein "EYE-CATCHER" sein welcher dieser dann "schwupps" mit paar Klicks auf dem Handy seinen Freunden, Familie, Arbeitskollegen, etc. als Kaufempfehlung weiterleiten kann ! Ein SHOPIFY-Account als "soul-food_&_art-deco", nebst dazu gestalterisch passende, erste, einfache Werbeflyer / Visitenkarten sind bereits vorhanden. ... und ohne Paypal kann ich nicht leben ... ;-) Online-Aktivitäten (Social-Media, shopify, ggf. weitere) wären bereits noch im Laufe d. J. geplant ! In meiner Planung und natürlich bei finanziell erfolgreichem Start-Up, würde sogar die Anmietung eines Büros, mit Werkstatt, Lager und gut ausgestatteter IT/EDV stehen ! Was mir wichtig ist • Primäres Ziel: Verkäufe generieren – jede Maßnahme soll darauf einzahlen. • Plattform: Instagram - ggf. Facebook / weitere. Falls Sie ergänzende Ideen für Facebook, Pinterest oder Weitere haben, können wir sie später gern besprechen, doch der Fokus bleibt Instagram. • Inhaltlicher Mix: hochwertig inszenierte Produktfotos sowie authentische Behind-the-Scenes-Einblicke (Atelier, Verpackung, Herkunftsgeschichten). Benötigte Leistungen 1. Kurze Analyse meines aktuellen Auftritts (oder Erstellung eines neuen Profils) inkl. Bio-Optimierung, visuellem Leitfaden und Hashtag-Research. 2. 30-tägiger Content-Fahrplan: Themen, Posting-Rhythmus, Formate (Feed, Story, Reels), jeweils mit Call-to-Action zum Kauf. 3. Gestaltungsvorlagen (Canva, Adobe Express o. Ä.) für Produktfotos und Behind-the-Scenes-Beiträge, die ich künftig selbst anpassen kann. 4. Empfehlung für gezielte Instagram-Ads (Budgetrahmen, Zielgruppen, Creative-Ideen), um erste Verkäufe anzustoßen. 5. Kurzes Onboarding-Dokument oder Video, das mir zeigt, wie ich den Plan eigenständig weiterführe. Ergebnis Ich erhalte eine praxistaugliche Roadmap inklusive aller Vorlagen, sodass ich meine Kunst- und Art-Deco-Stücke sichtbar mache und direkt Verkäufe erziele. Wenn die Zusammenarbeit gut läuft, ist eine laufende Betreuung denkbar. Aktuell besitze ich bereits 5 Handy-Nummern in 3 Handies und 4 Präsentations-Tablets PC: 3 leistungsstarke PCs (Intel I7 / XEON) und zwei Notebooks, bin also EDV-Freak ... Android: mhh ... so gerade noch - lieber Microsoft oder Linux ... Social-Medai: nö, bitte nicht mehr .. Ich will mich nicht mehr mit Facebook, Flickr, Insta, oder sonstige "Schlag-mich-tot" Plattformen mehr herumschlagen ... das sollte Ihre Aufgabe sein / werden !" Einen Facebook-Account gibt es seit vielen Jahren ungenutzt ... also keine großen Erfahrungen mit dem Zeugs ... Je nach Schema, Geschäftsverlauf, Honorar-Vorstellungen wäre ggf. eine Beteiligung auf Provisions-Basis, oder sogar Teilhaberschaft vorstellbar - denn dann genieße ich ab 2027 meine Rente und SIE arbeiten gefälligst ! ;-) lololo Bevor es ein halbe Buch wird, höre ich jetzt erst einmal auf ... Ich denke, ich habe die mögliche Komplexität, aber auch positive Geschäfts-Prognosen angesprochen und wie Sie merken, äußerst umfangreich ... ;-) Bitte um Vorschläge, Hilfe, weitere Ideen ... und viiieeel Geduld ! Denn: ich (m) bin Bj. 1962 und ziemlich altmodisch gestrickt, jedoch mit reichlich Erfahrungen (21 Jahre EBAY als Gewerbler mit über 3000 positiven Bewertungen), als ehem. internationaler Projektleiter EDV/IT zwangsweise analytisch, pragmatisch, zielorientiert bis zur Sturheit, jedoch auch "open-minded" denkend ! Ich freue mich auf eine eventuelle Zusammenarbeit ! shalom è ahavah Gerald Weber P.S.: leider oben vergessen ... ich kann zwar schon etwas English, aber deutschsprachig wäre mir aufgrund der Komlexität und der Notwendigkeit, sich klar und verständlich auszudrücken, dann doch lieber !!!

jobs.title: Website Redesign for Service Sales
jobs.description: I have an existing site that is overdue for a refresh, but the real driver behind this project is functionality: I need to start selling my professional services directly online. The current layout is static and purely informational, so the job centers on integrating a full e-commerce workflow while giving the interface a clean, contemporary facelift. jobs.title: VB6 Astro API Development
jobs.description: I have a mature astrology application written entirely in Visual Basic 6 and I now need a clean, well-structured API layer so the core engine can be called from other systems—first priority is seamless integration with external database systems. Here is what I’m after: • A standalone DLL or COM-visible library (VB6 compatible) that exposes the key calculation routines and data objects in a way a modern service can consume. • A thin REST/HTTP wrapper (preferably in .NET or classic ASP if you feel safer staying closer to VB6) that forwards incoming requests to the VB6 layer and handles JSON responses. • Connection logic that can talk to common relational databases—at minimum it should work with any OLE DB provider so we can plug in SQL Server, Access or another engine without rewriting code. • Clear, commented source code plus a short README illustrating example requests, connection string placeholders and expected response formats. Acceptance will be based on: 1. I can call an API endpoint from Postman, pass a sample birth-chart parameter set and receive the same calculation results the desktop UI shows. 2. The API can read and write records in an external database table I specify during testing. 3. All dependencies are documented and the project builds from scratch on a clean Windows VM running VB6 IDE and the chosen web stack. If you have solid VB6 experience and have bridged old codebases to REST or database services before, this should be straightforward. Looking forward to working together.

jobs.title: ISO 27001 SOC2 Readiness Consultant
jobs.description: RoleLens Technologies Private Limited is an early-stage B2B SaaS company building an AI-enabled hiring decision-intelligence platform for enterprises. We are beginning development of our MVP and want information security, privacy and compliance built into the product and operating model from the outset, rather than added shortly before an enterprise audit. RoleLens is subscribing to Sprinto for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness. Sprinto will provide the compliance platform, control framework, policy templates, monitoring, evidence workflows and onboarding support. We are looking for a hands-on, part-time GRC consultant who can act as RoleLens’ internal compliance programme owner and work directly with Sprinto, our Founder, technical leadership team, MVP development partner and, later, the independent auditors. This is not a high-level advisory role. We need someone who will take ownership, follow up on actions, maintain the required evidence and make sure controls are actually implemented rather than simply marked complete on a dashboard. - Time commitment and duration - Approximately 5 hours per week - Primarily remote - Some availability during Indian business hours will be required - Engagement will continue through ISO 27001 certification and the agreed SOC 2 audit cycle, including Type I and subsequent Type II preparation and audit coordination, where applicable - Working hours may vary slightly during readiness reviews and audit periods. Key responsibilities: The selected consultant will: - Set up and manage the ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness programme within Sprinto - Participate in working sessions with the Sprinto account management and compliance teams - Understand applicable controls, evidence requirements, ownership, dependencies and milestones - Conduct or coordinate the initial gap and readiness assessment - Develop a practical implementation plan aligned with the MVP development timeline - Coordinate with the Founder, Fractional CTO, development team and vendors to close compliance gaps - Help customise and operationalise policies rather than merely copy standard templates - Maintain the risk register, asset register, vendor register, evidence tracker, compliance calendar and action log - Support processes relating to access control, risk management, vendor management, change management, incident response, business continuity and information security - Ensure security and privacy requirements are reflected in the MVP architecture and engineering practices - Review the quality and sufficiency of evidence before controls are marked complete - Coordinate with the ISO 27001 certification body and SOC 2 auditor - Support audit queries, evidence submissions, remediation actions and closure - Provide a short weekly update covering progress, open actions, risks, dependencies and decisions required Expected deliverables: The engagement should result in: - Sprinto configured with appropriate controls and owners - Initial gap assessment and prioritised implementation plan - Essential policies, registers and operating processes in place - Reliable evidence collected and maintained - Security and compliance actions incorporated into the MVP build - ISO 27001 audit readiness and certification support - SOC 2 Type I readiness and examination support - Continued control monitoring and preparation for SOC 2 Type II, where applicable - Clear audit trail, action tracker and weekly reporting Candidate profile: We are looking for an individual consultant with approximately 3 to 7 years of hands-on experience in one or more of the following: - Information-security governance - Governance, Risk and Compliance - ISO 27001 implementation - SOC 2 Type I and Type II readiness - SaaS security and technology risk - Internal audit or external audit coordination - Cloud and software-development control environments The candidate should have participated meaningfully in at least one ISO 27001 certification or SOC 2 assurance cycle. Experience using Sprinto or a similar compliance-automation platform would be an advantage. Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, Lead Auditor, CISA, CISM or equivalent will be helpful, but practical delivery experience will matter more than certificates alone. What will matter most: We need someone who: - Works independently and follows through until actions are closed - Can translate compliance requirements into practical startup actions - Understands SaaS, cloud environments, access controls, software-development workflows and evidence trails - Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders - Can distinguish essential controls from unnecessary bureaucracy - Is comfortable challenging weak evidence or incomplete implementation - Can represent RoleLens professionally in discussions with Sprinto and auditors This is not suitable for someone looking only to provide templates, conduct an occasional review or offer high-level advice. How to apply? Please include the following in your proposal: - Briefly describe one ISO 27001 or SOC 2 assignment in which you personally participated. - Explain your exact role and what you personally delivered. - Mention whether you have worked with Sprinto or a similar platform. - Confirm whether you have supported ISO 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type I, SOC 2 Type II or a combination of these. - Share your availability for approximately five hours per week. - Quote your hourly rate or monthly fee for approximately 20 hours per month. - Mention any relevant certifications. - Share a redacted sample of a gap plan, risk register, control tracker or audit-readiness report, where possible. - Provide one or two client references for similar work. Please begin your proposal with the words “RoleLens GRC” so we know you have read the complete requirement. Individual consultants are preferred. Agencies should apply only if the named consultant who will personally perform the work is clearly identified. If you have successfully taken other SaaS startups from “zero to cert” and can commit roughly 5 hours per week over the next few months, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Web Nạp Tiền Viettel -- 2
jobs.description: Tôi muốn xây dựng một trang web cho phép người dùng nạp tiền điện thoại Viettel trực tiếp trên nền tảng. Mục tiêu là tạo quy trình nạp tiền đơn giản, an toàn và ghi nhận đầy đủ giao dịch. Các yêu cầu chính • Tích hợp với cổng thanh toán để người dùng thanh toán nhanh chóng, hỗ trợ thẻ nội địa và ví điện tử phổ biến. • Lưu trữ và hiển thị lịch sử giao dịch cho từng tài khoản, kèm bộ lọc ngày tháng và trạng thái. • Gửi thông báo rõ ràng (qua UI hoặc email/SMS tùy đề xuất) ngay khi nạp tiền thành công. Kỳ vọng sản phẩm 1. Giao diện web thân thiện, tối ưu cho thiết bị di động. 2. Hệ thống quản trị để kiểm soát giao dịch, tra soát và xuất báo cáo CSV. 3. Mã nguồn rõ ràng, chú thích dễ hiểu, bàn giao cùng hướng dẫn triển khai trên hosting phổ biến hoặc VPS. 4. Kiểm thử chức năng nạp tiền thành công/thất bại, bảo mật cơ bản (HTTPS, kiểm soát đầu vào, chống spam). Bạn có thể đề xuất ngôn ngữ lập trình, framework và cổng thanh toán phù hợp tại Việt Nam. Tôi đánh giá cao kinh nghiệm tích hợp API thanh toán và xử lý giao dịch viễn thông. Nếu đã từng triển khai hệ thống tương tự, vui lòng gửi demo hoặc mô tả ngắn gọn để tôi tham khảo.
